Until this row the re-seat emitted no event and the ledger read located_mass 1.0 for a construction whose sites carry a quarter of the mass

FY2024-25 only: the held FIRMS fire panel ends June 2024; the extension uses the documented fixed cropland substitute, with temporal TE4 and substituted spatial evidence. This allowance does not admit loss of the committed own-period FIRMS layers in FY2015-16 through FY2023-24.
